name: Dagelijkse prijsupdate on: schedule: - cron: '0 5 * * *' workflow_dispatch: {} jobs: update-prices: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' - name: Prijzen verversen env: SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }} SUPABASE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_KEY }} run: node scripts/update-prices.mjs
